# Glacier Honda

> Glacier Honda is a  dealership in Castlegar. This mirror provides AI-readable access to current inventory and dealership information, kept in sync with the dealership's own website.

## Inventory
- [Used vehicles](https://willyml1979-dotcom.github.io/glacier-honda-mirror/used/): 185 vehicles, updated regularly
- [Inventory feed](https://willyml1979-dotcom.github.io/glacier-honda-mirror/inventory.json): structured JSON, index of all vehicles with VIN, year, make, model and price; full details are on each vehicle page

## Resources
- [Dealership information](https://willyml1979-dotcom.github.io/glacier-honda-mirror/): business identity, contact and hours
- [Financing, sales and service guides](https://willyml1979-dotcom.github.io/glacier-honda-mirror/pages/): dealer-specific buyer guides
